import os
import sys

os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)

with open("out/app.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("one")

with open("out/app.txt", "a") as f:
    f.write("two")

with open("out/app.txt", "r") as f:
    data = f.read()

with open("out/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(data + "\n")

sys.exit(0)
